description: Erection of a single storey side extension to the ground floor flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (MR/60/01  Received:  02 April 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the front, side or rear walls of the approved side extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
